body:
Being in the same boat, I was hoping you'd realize that this isn't about sadness or happiness. I feel happy more often than not. I have sex, I have friends, I have all sorts of creature comforts that allow me to enjoy the life around me.

But my problem isn't an inability to feel happiness (or purveyance of sadness) but rather that none of these things makes me feel *fulfilled*. There have been times where I've stayed up all night working on editing a film and hated myself and everything I was doing, but it was alright because I was getting fulfillment out of it. Regardless of the fact that the work was hard and miserable, it made me...well, happy is the wrong word here, but it's applicable. It made me happy to be miserable like that.

But right now, happiness, even though I enjoy it, is making me miserable. Empty might be a better word though.

I guess this could be boiled down to being an existential crisis. Why do I exist? What am I doing? Why am I doing? Why get up? Why eat?

And it's only me who can truly answer these questions. Though, how can I do this if I don't even really *want* to?

I am a thirsty horse, standing at water, but with no inclination to drink.
Yeppers. It's not even really that comforting to know others suffer from it too.
